xwhatsapp-strokecopylinkgoogleAdd Al Jazeera on Googleinfo Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has threatened to “extend confrontation to US bases” in the region if Washington continues to urge “vessels to pass through mined waterways illegally”. The IRGC says its navy has struck four ships involved in oil transfers in the Gulf, and that three other vessels caught fire after hitting mines near the Strait of Hormuz.
